title: T-2800, T-2803: add a planted standing horse to the Western Hotel yard
body:
Adds one selectable reconstructed horse to the 1835 Western Hotel yard, with a 12-second planted weight shift, provenance card, bounded drawn-yard support and host visibility/pause/resource ownership. Modern CC BY 4.0 model credit is separate from reconstructed historical appearance and location.

Final source `f225b8ae541173e2dde6e576bb20c103f4c87106`, tree `43665a4b692d5283defba96f236aed14b3c02623`, integrates DEV `eb1a0d11a96767a715a136ee43d94097ddf5b9cd`. Canonical owners rebuilt the generated provenance metadata after the ordinary GitHub branch update; source/geometry and all existing people, vehicles and UI are preserved.

Fresh normal CI passed on this exact source: [gate](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/40004752292), [moving frames](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/40004752222), [report](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/40004742266). Actual PR checkout `60f4fb6100c93ae984d73fc3e427aa0e0bfdb84b` has parents [DEV, source] and tree `43665a4b692d5283defba96f236aed14b3c02623`; the report checked out the source itself. Human workflow has zero matches among 43 changed paths and is N/A, never counted as a fourth pass. Actual committed-HEAD changelog/ID/whitespace/publisher/mirror/site and planted-standing contract checks pass.

Original horse source eb1cafe passed all 1054 local checks/382 self-tests. Combined local G11 disconnected and stopped after spawnSync git EAGAIN; the owner explicitly approved using normal GitHub CI for this reviewed integration. That failed local run remains preserved, not relabelled.

One original mobile yard inspection failed before any appframe because Chromium could not create threads. Zero apprequests/captures; inputs unchanged and final owned-process cleanup proven. This is not visual or photographic acceptance. Standard-loader/Mixer proof covers 65 planted keys and 64 midpoints only. Photographic anatomy/eyes/coat/hair, full gaits, tack, teams, drivers and riding remain open under T-2800/T-2803.
